result.title: Conic Certification of Transformer Attention
result.comment: 56 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/chimera1001/conic-attention-cert
result.summary: Attention is the computational core of large language models, yet the verifiers that bound how far an attention head's output can move under input perturbations give no guarantee on how loose their bounds are. A weak certificate therefore cannot be told apart from a fragile model. We develop a conic programming theory of attention certification that supplies this guarantee. We prove that the difficulty lies not in the softmax but in the bilinear interaction of a varying query with the keys. This interaction makes certification NP-hard over boxes and inapproximable once the attention logits can move by a constant amount. A fixed query or listed token substitutions, by contrast, make the exact worst case efficiently computable. An exponential cone moment relaxation then certifies a head with an error bounded quadratically in the perturbation radius by computable quantities, an order that cannot be improved. We also show that relaxations that treat a network one operation at a time, linear bound propagation among them, pay on second-order terms a sum of per-operation maxima instead of one coupled maximum. Computational results on GPT-2 indicate that the theory carries over to a trained model. Against exact worst cases with the query fixed, the certificate attains the predicted second-order accuracy. It is tighter than linear bound propagation on every head, and the looseness of bound propagation tracks the predicted per-operation excess.

AI.brief_summary: 论文建立注意力认证的圆锥规划理论，证明认证难点来自 query 与 key 的双线性交互（盒约束下 NP-hard），并给出误差随扰动半径二阶增长且不可再改进的指数锥矩松弛，在 GPT-2 上优于线性界传播。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「注意力输出随输入扰动的紧界」或可作为证书式工具迁移到量化视觉证据对注意力与 latent 状态的影响，可供核查能否用于检验视觉旁路与证据使用程度。
